idleSub: Shiga kowane tayal don ganin menene shi. Yana ɗaukar kusan daƙiƙa 20.
pausedSub: Danna ko latsa Enter don ci gaba.
editingSub: An dakatar da wasan yayin da kake gyara.
emptyTitle: Babu abin da za a yi wasa da shi tukuna
emptySub: Ƙara wasu abubuwa a wannan wasan don ya zama mai yiwuwa a yi wasa.
copyNote: An kwafa. Manna shi inda kake buƙata.
copyFail: An zaɓi rubutun. Kwafe shi da Ctrl ko Cmd + C.
stageLabel: Wasan taswirar ra'ayoyi. Kai halittar zuwa kowane ra'ayi.
stageHow: Yi tafiya da maɓallan kibiya ko W A S D. Latsa N don zuwa ra'ayi na gaba. Latsa Escape don dakatarwa. Latsa Tab don ci gaba. Cikakken rubutun yana ƙarƙashin Karanta ba tare da wasa ba.
hintKeys: Kibiya ko WASD don tafiya. N don ra'ayi na gaba.
hintTouch: Taɓa taswirar ko yi amfani da maɓallan
guideText: Shiga tayal mai haske don gano menene shi. Kowane tayal da ka taɓa yana shiga taswirar.
readInstead: Karanta ba tare da wasa ba
